items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: But in '68 then I went back to play with Don Ewell at the Golden Nugget in Toronto

ctx.x: Well, we played -- Red and I played all around, out in Brooklyn and all around this area together. And in fact when Red took sick, I took his place down in Blues Alley when he was down in Washington and then I went back there for Tom Gwaltney about three weeks a couple of times a year until Tom sold the place to somebody else.

But in '68 then I went back to play with Don Ewell at the Golden Nugget in Toronto, and then -- and then I started going to the Poconos -- and then we had a group that taught school for -- out in Pratt University for the summer, for the summer session, and I think --
